description: This file defines a Java interface 'ThingModifyCommandResponse' extending other interfaces, meant to represent responses from commands that modify a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ThingModifyCommandResponse
classes.description: A Java interface representing responses to modify commands on a 'Thing', providing a method to set Ditto headers and inheriting behavior from parent interfaces.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the response object, returning the response type for chaining.
